title: Radial Ripple from Pointer
summary: A ripple starts exactly where the pointer lands, not at the centre.
description: Click coordinates are written into CSS variables, so the expanding circle originates at the real contact point.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
variations: Ripple on keyboard activation from the centre
ai_usage: Touch-first UIs. Read event.offsetX/Y, set --x/--y, and append a short-lived span; remove it on animationend so rapid clicks do not accumulate nodes.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Radial Ripple from Pointer</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "radial-ripple-click",
    "title": "Radial Ripple from Pointer",
    "summary": "A ripple starts exactly where the pointer lands, not at the centre.",
    "description": "Click coordinates are written into CSS variables, so the expanding circle originates at the real contact point.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "feedback"],
    "tags": ["ripple", "material", "pointer", "feedback", "click"],
    "tech": ["css", "js"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Ripple color", "default": "rgba(255,255,255,.5)" },
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Ripple duration", "default": "0.6s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Dark ripple for light buttons", "Ripple on keyboard activation from the centre", "Multiple concurrent ripples"],
    "ai_usage": "Touch-first UIs. Read event.offsetX/Y, set --x/--y, and append a short-lived span; remove it on animationend so rapid clicks do not accumulate nodes."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    :root { --c: rgba(255,255,255,.5); --dur: .6s; }
    .rip { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 1rem 2.4rem; border-radius: 12px; background: #7c5cff;
      color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
    .rip span.r { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
      animation: rip var(--dur) ease-out forwards; pointer-events: none; }
    @keyframes rip { to { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); opacity: 0; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="rip" id="rp" type="button">Tap anywhere</button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.getElementById("rp");
      b.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var r = document.createElement("span"), size = Math.max(b.offsetWidth, b.offsetHeight) * 2;
        r.className = "r"; r.style.width = r.style.height = size + "px";
        r.style.left = e.offsetX + "px"; r.style.top = e.offsetY + "px";
        b.appendChild(r);
        r.addEventListener("animationend", function () { r.remove(); });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
